ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C1-2,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 2-1 in
the area bound by:

West Fifth Avenue; South Sacramento Boulevard; the alley next south of and parallel
West Fifth Avenue; and a line 200 feet northeast of and parallel to South Whipple Street,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit Districts.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

LZ

laSon C. Ervin
